name: Shantadurga Temple, Kavlem

mythology: Shantadurga Temple, Kavlem at Kavlem, Ponda, Goa is dedicated to Goddess Shantadurga, known especially for Goa’s great peace-bringing Devi temple. Pilgrimage tradition places the shrine within India’s tirtha network — a seat where vows, gratitude, and family kuladevi / ishta devotion gather. Local sthala-purana and priestly teaching elaborate how Goddess Shantadurga blesses those who arrive with sincere intent; festival days intensify these beliefs through special alankara and community worship where practised.
